## Description
Briefly describe the change and its rationale.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing behavior to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## Quality & Verification Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines and passes `npm run lint`
- [ ] Zero `console.log` statements in production code (structured logger used)
- [ ] Automated tests added or updated (`npm run test` passes)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or tokens committed
- [ ] Tested on mobile / responsive viewports
- [ ] Nigerian NERDC curriculum integrity verified
